evaluation_scope: Object-conditioned part decomposition with oracle ground-truth object box/root; no test part mask, part name, or part count is used in prediction.

gate_to_final.format: HPID-Split candidate-gate to final-output linkage audit
gate_to_final.interpretation: C1-C3 measure candidate retention before fusion. A0-A3 use the same frozen C3 candidate set and measure final identity fusion. Correlations describe propagation, not an additional causal ablation of the appearance gate.

clipseg_ovparts_style.interpretation: CLIPSeg object-part prompting in the one-stage open-vocabulary part-segmentation style used by OV-PARTS baselines. Connected components are evaluated as part instances.

report.interpretation: Intervals estimate HPID-Split A3 minus each baseline. An interval including zero is reported as statistical comparability, not superiority.

report.candidate_scope: frozen accepted proposal masks from the original automatic run
report.evaluation_scope: end-to-end fusion and Part-ID assignment after frozen proposal generation; not a proposal-generator ablation
report.ground_truth_usage: all four predictions are completed before labels are loaded
Quality features and review flags are produced without labels; PACO labels are read afterward to score failure detection.

report.prediction_protocol: All five perturbations were prespecified for every parameter; all predictions for a case were completed before labels were read.
report.selection_protocol: No sensitivity variant replaces the frozen release setting and no test-set result is used to retune a threshold.

execution.precision_mode: model defaults; no explicit FP16/BF16 autocast override
execution.model_loading: included in each command-level total; the benchmark runner launches one isolated process per case
execution.fast_mode_45_second_statement: an internal implementation target, not a guaranteed latency bound

runtime.scope: Timings describe ground-truth-box object crops and include model loading in total. They do not measure full-image object detection.

parameter_registry.benchmark_isolation: Release defaults and the manually specified inventory were frozen before the independent test manifest was evaluated. Inventory development could use public PACO train/development taxonomy and the old development cases; this is disclosed rather than treated as zero-shot taxonomy discovery. Independent-test part labels and masks are never read by inference and are opened only for scoring.
parameter_registry.parameter_origin_note: Values are hand-engineered release constants or manual inventory rules, not estimates fitted on the independent test labels.
